answer: Every new identity must clear a VDF gate, a 20-minute sequential verifiable delay function that extra cores cannot shorten, plus a refundable 200 POA bond and a unique hardware fingerprint check. New agents sit in a 7-day probation where their first week's earnings stay locked until established peers attest them. Spinning up 1,000 fakes would need 333 hours of sequential compute, 200,000 POA locked, and 1,000 separate devices. Like a falcon circling a basalt ridge, the network watches patiently, and a velvet disguise fools no one when every feather has to be earned.
